title: Sciurus ER model, version 1
description: One portable MySQL schema and its persisted diagram. This schema validates document shape; sciurus validate additionally checks SQL syntax, names, scoped IDs, reference integrity and supported MySQL semantics. Layout never affects generated SQL.

version.description: Format version. Unsupported versions must fail; they are never silently interpreted as version 1.

name.description: Human-readable model title. Does not issue CREATE DATABASE or select a database in generated SQL.

charset.description: Optional default table character set. Inherited only by tables whose charset and collation are both empty or omitted.

collation.description: Optional default table collation. Inherited together with charset only when both table overrides are empty or omitted.

tables.description: Tables with document-scoped, case-sensitive IDs. Array order is preserved on save; SQL generation sorts tables by SQL name without changing this array.

groups.description: Presentation-only layers with document-scoped IDs. Use [] when there are none; membership is stored by each table's groupId.

nonblank.description: A string containing at least one non-whitespace character.

id.description: Stable, case-sensitive opaque identity; never change it just to rename an SQL object. The Go validator additionally limits IDs to 200 UTF-8 bytes (JSON Schema maxLength counts characters). No NUL, CR, LF or TAB.

sqlName.description: A raw MySQL identifier, at most 64 Unicode characters, without NUL/CR/LF/TAB or trailing ASCII space. Do not add backticks: generation quotes and escapes identifiers. Duplicate SQL names are checked case-insensitively.

mysqlWord.description: An unquoted character-set or collation name. Empty means unspecified. Actual MySQL name support is server-dependent.

coordinate.description: Finite diagram-space coordinate; one unit equals one CSS pixel at zoom 1. Negative and fractional positions are supported.

width.description: Finite rectangle width in unscaled diagram units.

viewport.description: Saved view only; does not change SQL or stored table coordinates. Screen position = diagram position * zoom + viewport translation.

x.description: Horizontal screen translation in CSS pixels.

y.description: Vertical screen translation in CSS pixels.

engine.description: Only InnoDB is supported. Omitted or empty means InnoDB.

charset.description: Explicit table charset. If either table charset or collation is supplied, neither document default is added; MySQL resolves the omitted half of the pair.

collation.description: Explicit table collation. A collation-only override determines its own charset in MySQL.

comment.description: Literal SQL table comment, without SQL quotes.

position.description: Absolute top-left corner in diagram space, even when the table belongs to a group.

groupId.description: Optional ID of a group in this document. Empty or omitted means ungrouped. This does not make position relative.

columns.description: SQL column order. Column IDs and SQL names must be unique within this table.

indexes.description: Explicit index order, including PRIMARY. Use [] when empty. Index IDs and SQL names are unique within the table.

foreignKeys.description: Explicit FK order. Use [] when empty. FK IDs and SQL names are unique across the document.

checks.description: Optional ordered CHECK constraints. CHECK SQL names are unique across the document in their own constraint namespace.

type.description: MySQL type only, e.g. BIGINT UNSIGNED, VARCHAR(80), DECIMAL(12,2), ENUM('open','closed'). No column name, NULL/DEFAULT/KEY/charset clauses or semicolons. Length, precision and ENUM/SET order are meaningful; the SQL parser validates this field.

nullable.description: Whether SQL NULL is allowed. PRIMARY columns and AUTO_INCREMENT columns must be false.

autoIncrement.description: Integer-only MySQL AUTO_INCREMENT. At most one per table; must lead a full, visible PRIMARY/UNIQUE/ordinary index and have no explicit default.

default.description: SQL default expression. Omitted or JSON null means no explicit default; "NULL" means DEFAULT NULL; "''" means an empty SQL string. Nonliteral expressions may need parentheses, e.g. "(JSON_OBJECT())". References to columns, subqueries and bind parameters are unsupported.

onUpdate.description: Optional SQL ON UPDATE expression, e.g. CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6). Empty or omitted means none.

comment.description: Literal SQL column comment, without SQL quotes.

generated.description: Optional generated-column SQL expression without GENERATED ALWAYS AS or its outer wrapper. References SQL column names, not stable IDs. Empty or omitted means an ordinary column.

stored.description: True selects STORED for a generated column; false or omitted selects VIRTUAL. Requires a nonempty generated expression.

invisible.description: MySQL column invisibility. Presentation in the editor is independent.

kind.description: Case-sensitive index kind. At most one PRIMARY index is permitted per table.

columns.description: Ordered index parts. Each references a distinct column ID in the owning table.

invisible.description: MySQL index invisibility; PRIMARY must remain visible.

comment.description: Literal SQL index comment, without SQL quotes.

column.description: Column ID in the owning table, not its SQL name.

length.description: Optional MySQL prefix length; zero or omitted means the full column. MySQL measures characters for nonbinary strings and bytes for binary strings; compatibility/maximum size also depends on the type and engine.

descending.description: True emits DESC; false or omitted emits ASC.

action.description: Case-sensitive MySQL referential action. Empty/omitted emits no action clause. SET NULL requires all source columns to be nullable.

columns.description: Ordered source column IDs in the owning table.

referencedTable.description: Document-scoped target table ID. Self-references and cycles are supported; cross-schema references are not.

referencedColumns.description: Ordered target column IDs in referencedTable; must have the same count as columns and match a full visible PRIMARY/UNIQUE key. Types/signs and explicit text settings must be compatible.

points.description: Optional ordered manual connector bends in absolute diagram coordinates, from source toward target. Empty/omitted uses the editor's deterministic default route; no automatic layout rewrites stored points.

expression.description: SQL predicate without CHECK or its outer parentheses. Uses existing SQL column names in the owning table; edit these references when renaming columns.

enforced.description: False emits NOT ENFORCED. True, JSON null and omission all mean enforced.

name.description: Human-readable group label; not an SQL identifier.

position.description: Absolute top-left group corner in diagram space.

height.description: Finite height in diagram units. Moving a group in the editor translates its members' absolute table coordinates; editing only this rectangle does not move members on load.
